SQL 160 replaces four existing live functions with CREATE OR REPLACE and creates nothing (owner 2026-11-12: "we are removing the mortgage handling for an additional check if an additional check is on the same request. There will be no more $5 charge"; agent pay for an additional check: "Stop paying it"; "if a user deposits a check outside of checksops they should NOT be charged $4"; a check deposited with no deposit record: "yes make that free too"; "start SQL 160 yes"; "merge 1832 when green and yes make that free too"). public.record_check_billing_event() (SQL 98, run by trg_record_check_billing_event on check_intake_items) charges check_processing only when the check has a deposit_items row whose provider is not manual_branch; public.accrue_mortgage_ops_billing(uuid) (live-only, run through tg_accrue_mortgage_ops_billing by tr_accrue_mortgage_ops_billing on mortgage_handling_requests) records no mortgage_ops_additional_check charge; public.earn_mortgage_agent_compensation(uuid) (SQL 47, run by tr_earn_mortgage_agent_compensation on mortgage_handling_requests) pays nothing for an additional check; public.tg_record_mortgage_handling_billing() (run by tr_record_mortgage_handling_billing on check_intake_items) records no $5 mortgage_handling event for an additional check. Kept: the $10 for a claim's first check and SQL 153's $5 for a 2nd mortgage company; charges already recorded are not changed. Each body is the one the read-only production billing trigger inspect of 2026-11-12 read (aws/tests/fixtures/sql160-live-billing-functions-2026-11-12.sql) with only the lines marked SQL 160 changed; the file refuses a live body that is neither the inspected one nor its own (55000 sql160_live_body_drift) and missing prerequisites (55000 sql160_prerequisite_missing). No table, trigger, policy, grant or data change; the db-readonly-validate trigger count is not affected. record_check_billing_event() is also in SQL 98's fingerprint, which moves with this body (nothing pending names SQL 98 as a predecessor). Expected pre-state in production: the four functions with the inspected bodies (release sql160 v1: 3a8bb0b11d59688642c98ace91bb15c562c362eea00b2ae9c73a166fee365229, releaseIntendedHash('sql160', the fixture's text)); staging's is read by its own read-live (accrue_mortgage_ops_billing and tg_record_mortgage_handling_billing have no repository CREATE, so staging may differ: a stop, not a fix-forward).
